fields.text: Which explorer reached the Americas in 1492, opening the way for European exploration of the New World?
fields.explanation: Christopher Columbus, sailing for Spain, reached the Caribbean islands of the Americas in 1492. His voyages began lasting European contact with the New World.
fields.hint: He sailed for the King and Queen of Spain with three ships.
fields.whyA: Magellan led the first voyage around the world and reached the Philippines in 1521, not the Americas in 1492.
fields.whyC: Vasco da Gama found the sea route from Europe to India around Africa (1498).
fields.whyD: Marco Polo travelled overland to China in the 1200s, long before 1492.
fields.explanationTl: Si Christopher Columbus, na naglayag para sa Spain, ang nakarating sa Americas noong 1492. Dito nagsimula ang tuloy-tuloy na contact ng Europe sa New World.
fields.hintTl: Naglayag siya para sa Hari at Reyna ng Spain gamit ang tatlong barko.

fields.text: Which of the following is a major greenhouse gas that traps heat in Earth's atmosphere?
fields.explanation: Carbon dioxide absorbs heat radiated by the Earth and traps it in the atmosphere, making it a major greenhouse gas. Oxygen, nitrogen and helium do not trap heat this way.
fields.hint: It is released when fuels like gasoline and coal are burned.
fields.whyA: Oxygen makes up about a fifth of air but does not trap heat.
fields.whyB: Nitrogen is the most plentiful gas in air but is not a greenhouse gas.
fields.whyD: Helium is a light, inert gas that does not trap heat.
fields.explanationTl: Ang carbon dioxide ay sumisipsip at nagtatrap ng init sa atmosphere, kaya major greenhouse gas siya. Ang oxygen, nitrogen at helium ay hindi nagtatrap ng init nang ganito.
fields.hintTl: Lumalabas ito kapag nagsusunog ng gasolina o uling.

fields.text: Which planet is the largest in the solar system?
fields.explanation: Jupiter is the largest planet in the solar system; its diameter is about 11 times Earth's. It is a gas giant made mostly of hydrogen and helium.
fields.hint: It is a gas giant famous for its Great Red Spot.
fields.whyB: Saturn is the second-largest planet, best known for its rings.
fields.whyC: Uranus is an ice giant, much smaller than Jupiter.
fields.whyD: Neptune is the farthest planet from the Sun, not the largest.
fields.explanationTl: Jupiter ang pinakamalaking planeta sa solar system; mga 11 beses ng Earth ang diameter niya. Gas giant siya na halos hydrogen at helium.
fields.hintTl: Gas giant ito na sikat sa Great Red Spot niya.

fields.text: Which is the traditional national dress of Filipino women?
fields.explanation: The baro't saya, a blouse (baro) worn with a long skirt (saya), is the traditional national dress of Filipino women; the Maria Clara and terno are its later forms.
fields.hint: Its name joins the Filipino words for blouse and skirt.
fields.whyA: The kimono is the traditional dress of Japan.
fields.whyC: The ao dai is the traditional dress of Vietnam.
fields.whyD: The cheongsam is a traditional Chinese dress.
fields.explanationTl: Ang baro't saya, blouse (baro) na may mahabang palda (saya), ang traditional national dress ng mga Pilipina. Ang Maria Clara at terno ay mga mas bagong anyo nito.
fields.hintTl: Pinagsamang salitang Filipino para sa blouse at palda ang pangalan nito.

fields.text: What is the national bird of the Philippines?
fields.explanation: The Philippine Eagle was declared the national bird by Proclamation No. 615 (1995), replacing the maya. It is found only in the Philippines and is critically endangered.
fields.hint: It is the large, endangered bird of prey found only in the Philippines.
fields.whyB: The maya was the former national bird before the 1995 proclamation.
fields.whyC: The kalaw is a native hornbill, not the national bird.
fields.whyD: The Philippine cockatoo is a native endangered parrot, not the national bird.
fields.explanationTl: Ang Philippine Eagle ang idineklarang national bird sa Proclamation No. 615 (1995), pumalit sa maya. Sa Pilipinas lang ito makikita at critically endangered.
fields.hintTl: Malaking ibon na mandaragit, endangered, at sa Pilipinas lang matatagpuan.

fields.explanation: Under RA 8491, Sec. 4, the flag is blue, white and red, with an eight-rayed golden-yellow sun and three five-pointed golden-yellow stars in the white triangle.

fields.hintTl: Isipin ang araw at tatlong bituin sa loob ng white triangle.
